text: ハナダ　シティの　みんか　おそわれる…　か！

structure.jp: ハナダ　シティの　みんか

patterns.name: 〜られる (passive)
patterns.explanation: The われる ending turns 'attack' into 'be attacked', so the house is the one it happens to. おそわれる = 'gets attacked'.

patterns.name: 〜か (musing)
patterns.explanation: か here is not a real question; the speaker is taking in what he just read. おそわれる…　か = 'attacked... huh'.
